description.value:
This sword is said to have been blessed by the Elation. It is definitely not a lethal weapon bringing death and slaughter, but one that brings... joy and laughter!

"Have you ever danced with the devil under the faint moonlight?"

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. For each affected creature, Strength increases by 1, maximum 20, and critical hits roll one additional weapon or spell damage die. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, increase ATK of all allies by 100 and CRIT DMG by 30% for the next battle.
